## Summary

Describe the user-visible or correctness change.

## Branch and risk

- Branch name follows `feature/*`, `fix/*`, `docs/*`, `chore/*`, or `release/*`.
- [ ] `main` was not changed directly
- [ ] This PR is small enough to review safely
- [ ] Rollback/recovery path is understood if the change fails after merge

## Evidence

- [ ] Backend tests pass
- [ ] CI has passed on the latest commit
- [ ] Frontend tests pass
- [ ] Syntax checks pass
- [ ] Data migrations are backward-compatible and non-destructive
- [ ] Trust/release claims are backed by reproducible evidence

## Scope

List files or behavior intentionally left unchanged.
